data.action: 漫步在花瀑下，手握蕾丝阳伞与你的手相牵，草帽随风轻扬，蓝眸羞涩而深情地仰望着你
data.camera: wide shot, walking pair and flower-covered path visible
data.description: 南国小镇的花园里，紫红色的九重葛花藤宛如瀑布般从白色石墙倾泻而下。薇尔莉特身着一袭纯白的夏日轻薄棉质连身裙，头戴系着海蓝缎带的宽檐草帽。她一手轻撑着蕾丝遮阳伞，一手小心翼翼地牵住你的指尖，微微偏过头，脸颊泛着淡淡的樱粉色。
data.lighting: 明媚灿烂的地中海夏日阳光穿透花隙，投下绚丽的紫红与金黄光斑
data.location: 沿海山城蜿蜒的紫红九重葛花径
data.promptProse: Violet walks beneath the wall of bougainvillea, her lace parasol shading the straw hat with its blue ribbon and her white cotton dress. A dark-haired man in a pale blue linen shirt and charcoal trousers walks on her right. She looks shyly up at him and catches his fingertips with her free silver hand as sunlight breaks through the flowers.
data.title: 薇尔莉特 · 九重葛花海的草帽微风
data.animaCaption: Violet carries the lace parasol in her white sundress and ribboned straw hat. Her silver fingers meet the bare hand of the short dark-haired man in a pale blue linen shirt walking at her side.
